subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw make Markdown heading-aware chunking the default memory_search behavior, add an explicit chunking strategy/config, or defer chunking until the broader Memory MVP/entity design is settled?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes persisted index identity and retrieval behavior, and the issue also bundles a larger entity/graph-memory direction that needs product ownership.

options.title: Approve a narrow chunking design
options.body: Implement heading-aware chunking as a focused memory-core change with explicit reindex semantics and track entity extraction separately.

options.title: Make heading-aware chunking default
options.body: Adopt Markdown heading boundaries as canonical for memory files and accept that existing headed files will reindex and retrieve differently.

options.title: Defer to Memory MVP design
options.body: Keep this open while chunking, extraction, wiki synthesis, and durable memory schema are settled together.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow chunking design
recommendation.body: Implement heading-aware chunking as a focused memory-core change with explicit reindex semantics and track entity extraction separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a memory product/default and plugin-boundary decision, and steipete has the strongest sampled history for that boundary.
